name: Slack Assistant
description: Remembers what happens in your Slack and tells you what you missed
author: flock

examplePrompts: What did I miss in Slack today?
Did anyone ask me for something this week?
Summarise the thread about the launch
What have I promised people on Slack?

skills.description: Read your Slack workspace — channels, DMs, mentions and saved items

accountRequirement.setupGuide: Log in to Slack in the Flock dashboard browser session

setupChecklist.label: Identity configured
setupChecklist.description: Set a name, avatar, and description for your assistant

setupChecklist.label: Agent instructions set
setupChecklist.description: Agent instructions define what your assistant watches for and how it reports back

setupChecklist.label: Connect Slack
setupChecklist.description: Log in to Slack so your assistant can read the conversations you choose

setupChecklist.label: Choose what it reads
setupChecklist.description: Open the daily Slack routine and pick your channels. Leave it empty and it reads what is already addressed to you — DMs, mentions and saved items.
